fixture.selection: First 128 distinct CSS identifier class tokens in the frozen HTML, source order; no resource mutation or redownload.

qualification: Two borrowed optional helpers distinguish present/empty/missing string and pseudo buckets with one get_check; pointers remain identical to map values and no array clone/allocation occurs. Collector and iterator preserve ordering, quirks, pseudo metadata, ownership and live replacement/removal. Twenty-six functions run under both double/single lookup policies in ordinary GC, no GC, poisoned preallocation and ASan/UBSan. O2 component retains four ABBA observations per variant; 65536 lookups per case and 100 full candidate collections use the first 128 distinct identifier classes from frozen HTML. Setup, parse and warm collection excluded; checksums/full ordering verified after counters. Component gains are not page instruction credit.
